  Submitted by: Veronica Petrosyan
  Submitting Department: Health and Environmental Control Department
  Meeting Date: December 21, 2022

SUBJECT
Presentation on the Environmental Sustainability Action Plan Update Project

Recommendation:
No action is required by the Green Vernon Commission. This is a presentation only.

Background:
In 2011, the City developed an Environmental Sustainability Action Plan (Plan) as a detailed,
long-range strategy to achieve sustainability in the sectors of greenhouse gas (GHS) emission,
energy, transportation, land use, solid waste, water, biological resources, air quality, public
health, and economic development. On August 24, 2022, the Green Vernon Commission
(Commission) directed staff to proceed with updating the Plan and appointed two
Commissioners to a temporary ad hoc committee to work with the staff Steering Committee to
provide support, guidance, and oversight of the Plan update project. Subsequently, the City
executed a services agreement with Environmental Science Associates (ESA) for
environmental sustainability action plan technical consulting services effective September 1,
2022. ESA is in the initial phase of its work and will deliver a presentation on the status of the
Plan update project to the Commission.

Fiscal Impact:
There is no fiscal impact associated with this report.

Attachments:
None.

3.  Environmental Sustainability Action Plan

  Health and Environmental Control Director Agyin presented the staff report.

MOTION

  Direct staff to proceed with the process to update the City's Environmental
  Sustainability Action Plan adopted in 2011; and B. Appoint Commissioner Browne
